value.rationale: An exact closed stationary law and a globally sharp three-singularity to one-mode threshold are supplied for the first natural symmetric all-to-all three-state switching process. This directly addresses the motivating multienvironment analytical difficulty while distinguishing it from the prior line-graph dynamics, gives a complete extremum count and edge critical laws, and removes numerical stationarity integration in this case. The result is a motivated exact natural classification, not an arbitrary parameter lookup.
